articles.title: When Institutions Stop Listening, Democracy Begins to Bleed
articles.summary: Democracy is not sustained by elections alone. It depends on institutions that respect the Constitution, protect citizens’ rights, act transparently and remain accountable to the people. When those entrusted with public power fail to discharge these responsibilities, democracy may continue to function formally while its foundations are gradually weakened.
